description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractHeaderValueValidator' which provides a base implementation for validating header values in a system, including mechanisms for responsibility checking and value validation customization.

classes.name: AbstractHeaderValueValidator
classes.description: An abstract class that implements common functionality for header value validation, including responsibility checks and chaining validators.

methods.name: AbstractHeaderValueValidator
methods.description: Constructor that takes a predicate to determine if the validator is responsible for a certain Java type.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Validates a header definition and value if responsible, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: canValidate
methods.description: Checks if the validator can handle a given Java type.

methods.name: andThen
methods.description: Provides a way to chain this validator with another validator.
